asr.full_text: Woohooo, yeah, you must have gotten late Why don't you say anything you do not follow me I am a cop What's up you guys. Alright guys, let's make a move. Jayes is the one driving the GS, and making memories of Delhi come alive. It was a lot of fun driving there. I still have all the options but I'm choosing it. And look at this F6B. That's the H2, right now some of the bikers are joining us, I think Prateek will join us too. Let's do Rathgi Geedi, Mumbai Darshan Biker style Yeah ! And I am always ready for such experiences in different cities I enjoy it a lot Love it a lot Haha crazy public reactions And we'd like to get in the USA. But we are still going on the same route. You can also find cars made in the city, especially the ones sold in India are also not good. Bro! Did you see that? A girl went there looking at all the bikes and showed off her thangas I'm sure you must have seen it in the previous frame That was different man She gave a vote in a minute, thumbs up or thumbs down She forgets things and she remembers the same ones K2K is a great party, I got to meet a lot of people This is the new We think that the handle is out but the bike is out. But the van is a bit out, the pannier. So we have to take care of that. And now we'll get some traffic. And there's a lot of hustle in Mumbai. There are a lot of people here. Places, places, places, places, places. So we're taking a detour I guess. Because I could see a jam ahead. So we'll take the streets and reach downtown. Oh my! Look there. It feels like Dubai. Look how big it is. This is cute too. It's not too bulky from the back. It's sleek and has a good pannier on the side. It looks like a boat, you just have to put it in the water and it will work. Guys, did you see that? The guy moved the bike like this and hit it. Oh my god.. It's very risky. People get charged and then.. I swear to god! There it is, lights on. Very nice thing. They've given us rave bombs on the S2. We've heard a lot of noise up to here. Is it the friend of the car or the demand of the car? Look at the number. Oh, our brother has... Where are you going? Ohoho, our brother has...brother... Where are you going? I gave a high five to a subscriber And guys we are on Marine Drive. It means that it has started properly from here but you can see the rush. There are a lot of people now. I mean there are people coming up, down, right, left, up, down, round and round. And everyone is looking at us. Local people are going on my left. Lifeline of Mumbai. Just wow. I'm sure you guys know what it is so please comment down. Guys on my left, lifeline of Mumbai, just wow! I'm sure you guys know what it is so comment down below. And there are waves here too bro, I think the ocean is sending waves. Kanya ji's new crush, look at this. Are you on Youtube? Yeah, find Khanna Omkar! You can search me on insta, Khanna Omkar. You can search me on Instagram, Khanna Omkar. Khanna Omkar, I'll follow you. Follow me now. Will you follow me now? Yeah, sure! Follow her now. Khanna won't be able to sleep at night, yeah! Dhana's hashtag is happy! That's good, that's good, bro! Last time she was standing on the lorry. Yellow colored. Power wheelie. a Beetle on yellow flag. Power wheelie. Biker inside. Looks like he is following me back saying yeah yeah sure sure he is saying sure and says he got all the English correct Omg This is the end point. we have to take a U turn to reach the port. What a line up bro! So we just finished the photo shoot in front of Taj. Now let us leave from here because in a little while, it will be lockdown. lockdown, the night curfew will start in a little while And then, something worse can happen So far, so good Come, your driver is ready Sit down, sir This was fun, bro, really fun! Bye, Taj! Bye! This has been called the Old Taj, and this is the new build, new Taj. Wow! Wow… wow! A must-try thing for Vada Pav in Mumbai. Baby, baby, baby, this is just for the demonstration. 1.5 lakhs, 1.5 lakhs, 1.5 lakhs. Are you kidding me? This is the church. And this is the camera. Okay. Okay. So guys this is a very famous church. If you have watched the movie Amar Akbar Anthony, so a lot of people are standing here, so this is a place very famous here, I am coming for the first time. I am also coming for the first time, I keep coming, so you can come here for 100% Okay, will you get what you ask for? If you want you can put the bike candle, if you want the money candle. If you put the candle, you will get it a bike, you can put on a house, you can put on money. If I put on a candle, will I get it? Yes, you can put on 100%. So our brother says he's very fond of this place, light a candle and ask for your wish and you'll be fulfilled. So we'll try this surely. And anyway I always thank you guys for giving me so much without asking, I've got your love and this is a good life. We'll try to come tomorrow, definitely. He thought I'm a real man. did you have the Samsung? Oh my God what a bad PJ 2 to 2 so guys Almost its 2 o clock we are here in Wapace Hotel and really it was a long day it was fun now we are tired we finished the ride and then we ate and and we kept on eating keep on eating What happened was that we finished the ride and had dinner. And then we started talking so much that we didn't know when it was 2-2.30 PM. And Khanna ji had hit someone in the eye. And the eye got hurt. Is it hurt sir? Yes bro. We are very tired. And something went into his eye while riding the bike. So I was riding while sitting in the back. So that is a problem. He is getting irritated. He is getting irritated. He was sitting on the back seat while I was riding the bike. So that is a problem. He is getting tired. He was getting itchy. If he gets better by tomorrow, then it's fine. But if not, then I have to ride the bike the next day. There is no option. Jacky is sleeping. And he called us at 2-3 am but we were very far. We were 40 km away. So we told him to rest at the hotel. We will come back in the night I will bring their dinner with us We told them to bring the dinner They woke us up at 2.30 PM Anyway friends We will be closed soon. Let us know about what you want to see in the next video And again, Happy new year guys You have to wait for the upcoming videos for tomorrow is the time for the test If the test part done then we will proceed for K2G. If we don't get there tomorrow, we either have to stay in Mumbai or K2G. No no no. It won't be that easy. There won't be any twist in the story so let's hope that tomorrow we will get a new part done. And then we will start our journey. That's it for today. I am tired. Sorry. Bye. Good night. Sleep tight. Mayana Tamari. Rehmat-us-ki. Pray for me. We have never ended like this, we do it so low. Hashtag Sustana Shet. Still, you are still doing this. It was very tiring. We slept for 5 hours. We came from Goa yesterday. We will sleep now
